insights.title: Collective-blame share rose in the monitored YouTube sample
insights.summary: In the fixture window, items classified as likely collective blame grew as a share of Muslim-relevant items. The rise coincides with a busier collection week. It is not a claim that any event caused the change, and it is not a prevalence estimate for YouTube as a whole.

facts.claim: Likely-hate items among relevant items were 74 of 312 (23.7 percent) in this window.
Collective-blame items were 21 of the 74 likely-hate items (28.4 percent).
